tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
forgotIntro: Enter your username or email. If an account exists, you will receive a link to choose a new password.
forgotDone: If an account matches, an email has just been sent. The link is valid for 30 minutes.
passwordRules: At least 8 characters, with letters, numbers and special characters.
weakPassword: This password does not meet the rules.
invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
setPasswordDone: Your password is saved. You can now sign in.
passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
samePassword: The new password must be different.
mfaSetupIntro: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis…), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
recoveryCodesIntro: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each works only once and lets you sign in if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
mfaBannerAdmin: Your account has administrator rights. Turn on two-step verification to protect it.
mfaBannerUser: Protect your account with two-step verification.
mfaMandatory: Two-step verification is required for your role.
mfaUnavailable: Two-step verification is unavailable right now.
codesRemaining: You have {{count}} recovery code(s) left. Consider generating new ones.
